(Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound is prepared by a method comprising enolization of a β-keto ester precursor under conditions that selectively form the sodium enolate__.

2. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits enhanced stability compared to the corresponding potassium enolate analog__.

3. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl, __wherein the compound is the sodium enolate of a β-keto methyl ester__.

4. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is sodium and the compound is prepared by enolization of a β-keto methyl ester__.
